item.title: Middle East Live: US strikes Iran for first time in a month, Tehran retaliates
item.description: US forces struck what they described as Iranian rocket launchers on the Strait of Hormuz in their first military action in a month on Sunday, breaking a lull in fighting during an intermittent war that has lasted more than six months. In turn Iran struck military bases in Jordan and the UAE on Monday, saying that it was acting in legitimate self-defence. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.

item.title: US-led Gaza peace board warns Hamas over kites after Israeli threat
item.description: The US-led board overseeing the Gaza peace plan warned Hamas on Tuesday to halt militant activity, including flying kites, after Israel threatened retaliatory strikes. A Board of Peace official said Israel must also respect the ceasefire, limiting military action to responses to “genuine and imminent threats.”

item.title: These Generals Fought for Israel. Now They See ‘Jewish Terrorism’ as the Threat.
item.description: A growing number of former Israeli generals, intelligence officials and prime ministers are accusing settlers in the West Bank of committing ethnic cleansing with government support. “Once a society behaves this way,” one said, “that society is doomed.”

item.title: Middle East live: Iran says Hormuz strait still closed despite transit corridor talks with Oman
item.description: President Donald Trump on Wednesday said he believes Iran’s Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei is “very seriously wounded”, but not dead. Khamenei has not been seen in public since the US and Israel launched the Iran war in February, prompting months of speculation over the new Iranian leader’s health. Follow our liveblog to see how the day's events unfolded.

item.title: 'Retrospective incrimination: First we shoot, we kill, and then we find a reason why it happened'
item.description: Liza Kaminov is pleased to welcome Nadav Weiman, Executive Director of Breaking the Silence. He says there is a troubling gap between how Israeli military operations in Gaza are publicly explained and what soldiers experience on the ground. Testimonies collected by Breaking the Silence suggest that this gap is not simply about individual incidents, but about the policies, assumptions and rules of engagement. item.title: מונעים על ידי אמונה, פעילים יהודים עומדים מול מתנחלים כדי להגן על הפלסטינים בגדה המערבית
item.description: קבוצה של ישראלים שנוסעת בקביעות לגדה המערבית כדי להגן על פלסטינים שנפלו קורבנות להתקפות מתגברות של מתנחלים אומרים שאמונתם היהודית דחפה אותם לפעילות. שלשום, לפחות חמישה פעילים נפצעו כשמיהרו לסייע לפלסטינים שהוטרדו על ידי מתנחלים בכפר ג'ננתח, הסמוך לבית לחם.

item.title: Netanyahu condemns violence in West Bank
item.description: It was a rare condemnation from what is widely seen as the most religious and ultranationalist government in Israel’s history. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu condemned recent attacks by Israeli settlers on Palestinians in the occupied West Bank, but described the violence as the actions of a “handful of rioters.” Tensions have surged across the territory, with activists accusing settlers of acting with impunity. Much of the recent violence has taken place in the town of Qusra. Peter O’Brien

item.title: נתניהו מגנה את 'מעשי האלימות הפליליים' של מתנחלים בכפרי הגדה המערבית
item.description: ראש ממשלת ישראל בנימין נתניהו גינה בשבת את מה שכינה "מעשי אלימות פליליים" שבוצעו על ידי מתנחלים ישראלים בשני כפרים פלסטינים. מוקדם יותר באוגוסט, קבוצת מתנחלים חסמה את כניסת האספקה ​​לבתים פלסטינים בפאתי קוסרה ותקפו משפחה פלסטינית וצוות תקשורת זר בג'אלוד הסמוכה.

item.title: Several killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza and West Bank
item.description: Israeli strikes in Gaza have killed five people, local hospital officials said Friday. Two brothers and another relative died in a strike on the family’s home outside Khan Younis, officials at Nasser Hospital said. Two separate Israeli strikes killed one person each in Gaza City, according to health officials at Shifa hospital.

item.title: Israel army carries out rare West Bank air strike, killing 'three terrorists'
item.description: Israel's military said it carried out an air strike in the Jenin area in the West Bank on Friday that killed a ​Palestinian it described as a Hamas militant operative as well as two of his accomplices, in a rare use of deadly Israeli air power in the occupied territory.
